action.description: Required only for kind=reaction: add or remove.

channel.description: Required for every kind: member channel ID or name.

deliverable.description: Optional Cassy publication metadata; accepted and ignored by the hub.

epic_id.description: Optional Cassy epic metadata; accepted and ignored by the hub.

file.description: For kind=file use this single file object or files[], never both: filename and content; content_encoding is text (default) or base64. Decoded content maximum 1048576 bytes. Optional content_type, sha256, size_bytes, title.

file_id.description: Required for single-file external step=complete: use file_id returned by begin; with files[] put each file_id in its entry.

filename.description: Required for single-file external steps (omit with files[]); use file.filename for kind=file.

files.description: Optional alternative to single file/metadata: 1–10 files, one shared initial_comment/reply_to. kind=file entries use filename/content (text or base64), aggregate decoded limit 1048576 bytes. kind=file_external entries use filename/size_bytes/sha256/title?, and complete also requires file_id for every entry. External flow carries no bytes in MCP requests.

idempotency_key.description: Required only for kind=thread: stable key (1–200 characters) scoped to caller/channel. Reuse with identical content to obtain receipts or resume a confirmed pre-write failure. Active/unconfirmed writes are never automatically replayed.

initial_comment.description: Optional comment for file or either file_external step; supplied to Slack on complete.

kind.description: message: text, optional reply_to; file: nested file or files[], optional initial_comment/reply_to; file_external: step plus filename/size_bytes/sha256 or files[] (complete also needs file_id per file); reaction: message_id, reaction, action; edit: message_id, text; delete: message_id; thread: text, replies[], idempotency_key.

message_id.description: Required for reaction, edit, or delete. To change text use kind=edit, not kind=message.

operator_override.description: Optional Cassy override metadata; accepted and ignored by the hub.

reaction.description: Required only for kind=reaction: canonical emoji name without colons.

replies.description: Required only for kind=thread: 1–20 ordered replies, each text and/or files[]. Files use inline content or previously uploaded external file_id/filename/size_bytes/sha256/title? metadata. Maximum 10 files per reply and 1048576 aggregate inline bytes across the whole thread. Encode local files client-side or prepare external uploads before calling.

reply_to.description: Optional parent message ID for message, file, or either file_external step.

sha256.description: Required 64 hexadecimal SHA-256 characters for single-file external steps (omit with files[]).

size_bytes.description: Required positive byte length for single-file external steps (omit with files[]). Hub external ceiling is 1000000000 bytes per file; Slack workspace policy may impose a lower limit. Above 1048576 decoded bytes use external uploads, never inline base64.

step.description: Required only for kind=file_external: begin returns upload_url/file_id; upload bytes directly, then complete with the same metadata.

task_id.description: Optional Cassy task metadata; accepted and ignored by the hub.

text.description: Required for kind=message, kind=edit, or kind=thread (top-level text); edit also requires message_id.

title.description: Optional title for single-file external steps (use per-entry title with files[]); supplied to Slack on complete.
